name: Rio Wirawan
title: Senior Android Developer
tagline: Native Android features for mobile banking.
summary: I build native Android features in Kotlin for OctoMobile, a mobile-banking application — including QR payments, card management, cardless transactions, and the receipts and feedback around them.

experience.summary: UI and integration work in Kotlin with the VIPER architecture for the OctoMobile mobile-banking application.
highlights: QR payments: QRIS and cross-border QR, merchant- and customer-presented flows, QRIS Tap and QRIS Transfer.
QR receive-money, send-money and customer-presented QR generation, with receipts and summaries delivered through push notifications.
Card management for debit and credit cards: block, activate and change PIN.
Account detail screens for credit cards, savings and current accounts, and time deposits.
Cardless withdrawal and deposit, including viewing active codes.
Point transfers, virtual card numbers, and credit-card, loan and loan top-up application flows.
Testing builds before final review to verify issue resolution, and taking part in code review.

experience.summary: Web and mobile projects for clients, from requirements to delivery.
highlights: Defined requirements and deliverables with clients and agreed fees and contracts.
Implemented user-interface designs and new features for web and mobile applications.
Optimized performance and debugged production issues to minimize disruption.
Used client feedback to identify improvements.

experience.summary: Taught Android and desktop programming to university and high-school students.
highlights: Planned and delivered curriculum for more than 75 students.
Designed classes, and prepared and graded examinations and assignments.

courses.title: The Complete Android 12 & Kotlin Development Masterclass
Theoretical and Practical Understanding of Kotlin
